name: Studio
idea: A dark, textured investor deck: wide technical type, treated photography, one accent, numbers in a bento grid.
brief: The deck of a design studio's best pitch work (owner's references, 2026-10-09). A dark ground with film grain; ONE accent used sparingly, as a light in the frame. Display type wide and technical, often uppercase and tracked, or a grotesk with a single italic word for emphasis. Every slide carries editorial chrome: tiny uppercase labels in the label face in two or three corners (the deck's name, the section, the page as '04 — 10'), and fine hairlines dividing the canvas into a visible grid. Imagery is photography treated in the deck's colours: full-bleed behind the title on the cover, cropped into columns or cards elsewhere. Numbers sit in a bento grid of UNEQUAL cards (one large, the rest smaller), or as a big figure with a striped progress bar beside it. Light slides, when used, are a pale ground with the same chrome. Generous dark space; nothing centred unless it is the cover's one line.
never: bright light grounds on more than two slides

styles: cinematic photograph, dramatic motion blur, shallow depth of field, dark, high contrast, editorial
